sources.entry: Huly - All-in-one project management platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion). (Demo, Source Code) EPL-2.0 Docker/K8S/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Huly Platform is a framework for building business applications such as CRM, chat, project management, HRM and ATS, from the Huly project's monorepo (frozen, development moved to Platform-Collective/platform).
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the source for the Huly Platform, a framework meant to speed up building business applications, and the Huly applications built on it: Chat, Project Management, CRM, HRM and ATS. It is a Rush-managed monorepo that builds with Node.js and runs locally through Docker Compose with services such as MongoDB, Elasticsearch and MinIO. The README describes a typed API client for programmatic access and separate production (v*) and development (s*) release tags. It also covers build, dev-server, unit tests, UI tests (via BrowserStack) and native Windows and WSL build guides. The README states the repository is frozen and no longer actively maintained, and that hosted Huly has shut down.
use_cases: self-host a project management and CRM app
build custom business applications on a framework
develop or contribute to the Huly codebase
run a local Huly development environment with Docker
build integrations using a typed API client
notable: Single framework powering several apps: Chat, Project Management, CRM, HRM and ATS
Docker-based local environment with a minified variant for low-resource machines
Typed API client and examples repository for programmatic use
Native Windows build support via Git Bash, plus a WSL build guide
caveats: Repository is frozen and no longer actively maintained; development continues in Platform-Collective/platform
Hosted Huly has shut down; self-hosting is the remaining option
Local installation cannot send email, so password recovery and email notifications do not work
Installing dependencies requires a GitHub token with read:packages scope for GitHub Packages
